text:
olga: Heads-up — we just saw a ~4x spike in fncall validation failures for the /chat/invoke route starting ~10:03 PST. Dashboard shows a big lump under 'validation_errors' but no clear reason buckets.
kevin: Which variant/route did they hit? any region skew?
olga: Mostly us-west-2, route_id=router-v2, model-variant=short-ctx-degen. Quotas show rejects but billing attribution still counts as success in some reports.
ashley: can you paste a sample log line?
olga: sure, from the edge logs:
```
2026-03-23T17:03:12Z INFO invoke.request id=abc123 route=router-v2 region=us-west-2 model=short-ctx-degen status=validation_reject reason="output_shape_mismatch" schema=/schemas/chat_tool_v2.json
2026-03-23T17:03:12Z WARN fncall.validator id=abc123 stage=post-invoke details="expected object, got array"
```
kevin: ok so validator knows reason but we don't persist a structured reason into our telemetry event that the console uses?
diana: right — console only shows a generic "validation error" tag. No dimension for `reason` or `variant` in the error-heatmap. Makes triage and quota accounting hard.
sre-bot: alert: validation_error_rate for /chat/invoke crossed 3% (threshold 1.5%) in us-west-2 at 17:03:20Z
ashley: if telemetry contained `validation_reason` and `route_variant` we could: filter dashboards, attribute to quota buckets, and display human-readable tooltips. Also useful for automated rollbacks.
kevin: suggestion: add two new fields to the invoke error event: `validation_reason` (enum limited to the validator taxonomy) and `validator_version`. Keep them nullable to avoid bloat. Backfill existing events with a sampling job later.
olga: +1. Also need to ensure we don't leak user PII in reason text. Use stable enum keys like `output_shape_mismatch`, `missing_required_field`, `json_parse_error`.
diana: billing asked why some rejects still look billable — our current pipeline marks the token billing on arrival, not after validation. If we add `validation_outcome` to the final delivery event, we can update billing reports to exclude hard rejects. Will need a migration window.
ashley: UX ask for console: add a filter for "validation_reason" and a small inline legend in the invoke timeline. Also surface the last failing example (redacted) so engineers can inspect patterns.
kevin: implementation notes: runtime already attaches validator result to the internal request context. Two places to change: 1) event emitter (add the fields to the kafka message), 2) metrics ingestion (map the enum to a tag), 3) console index (add the new column + filter).
sre-bot: note: adding a new metric tag will increase cardinality. Recommend sampling at 5% for the first 48h while we validate sizes.
olga: agree on sampling; but we should route 100% of any events flagged `error_rate > 2%` for full capture until human ack. Means dynamic sampling override for anomaly windows.
diana: timeline: engineering to ship runtime + emitter change (kevin/ashley) -> console schema update (console-bot) -> small billing backfill job (finops). Can we do a canary?
kevin: yes, canary plan: enable full reason tagging for 10% of traffic on a debug route (router-v2-canary) for 24h, track cardinality & payload size. If OK, expand. Also expose `soft_validate=true` toggle: when enabled, validator attaches reasons but doesn't reject, so we can gather telemetry without affecting users.
ashley: UX will show soft_validate traffic separately and label it clearly. Also want a checkbox to "Include soft validation samples" in the heatmap.
diana: billing: we'll need a deterministic rule to mark events as non-billable: `validation_outcome == hard_reject` AND `validator_version >= X`. We'll coordinate with finance.
kevin: quick proto for the kafka event schema change (minimal):
```
{ "event_type": "invoke_result", "route_id": "router-v2", "validation_outcome": "hard_reject|soft_reject|pass", "validation_reason": "output_shape_mismatch|missing_required_field|json_parse_error|...", "validator_version": "v1.4.2" }
```
olga: also add `route_variant` and `region` as tags to make dashboard joins easier.
console-bot: NOTE: console index requires a migration. Adding `validation_reason` as a filterable field will add ~+2.4GB to the index for 30 days at current sampling.
sre-bot: operational checklist: alert update, pager runbook note, sampling override implementation, cardinality dashboards.
kevin: action items: (1) runtime/emitter PR by EOD tomorrow (owner: kevin), (2) canary config + sampling override (owner: olga), (3) console index PR (owner: ashley), (4) billing rule draft (owner: diana).
ashley: will prep console mocks today.
diana: I'll loop in finance after we have the reason taxonomy.
olga: I'll kick off a short grep job to find recent examples and attach a few redacted snippets to the ticket.
kevin: will add unit tests that ensure `validation_reason` is a stable enum and doesn't contain free text.
ashley: thanks — let's sync in the 11am triage. If anyone sees a new spike, pls ping #incidents too. :thumbsup:
olga: thanks all.
